context:
Treat the top-level module as a cleanup decision. Revalidate imports first,
then either delete dead code with coverage or quarantine/document it if there
is a real consumer.
description:
The platform support-status inventory found `benchbox/platforms/cudf.py`, a
legacy top-level GPU adapter module that imports `benchbox.experimental.gpu`.
Current registry metadata classifies `cudf` as experimental DataFrame support,
and DataFrame execution routes through the DataFrame platform family instead
of this top-level module.

Decide whether the legacy module should be removed, moved behind a repo-only
experimental boundary, or integrated into the supported DataFrame path.

anti_patterns.dont: delete the module based only on filename inventory
make GPU helper imports run during base benchbox import.

deferrals.reason: GPU helper promotion needs a separate product/API decision.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: Promoting cuDF GPU-metrics helpers to a stable public API is contingent on and subsumed by the open module-fate item (which has an 'integrate into supported path' option). Premature while cudf.py is experimental/under-review. (tracked by remove-or-integrate-legacy-cudf-platform-module)
deferrals.summary: Promote GPU metrics helpers to a stable public platform API

preserves.behavior: Do not promote benchbox.experimental.gpu to public support without an explicit contract decision.
Do not remove working DataFrame cuDF support while handling the legacy top-level module.

prior_art.concept: benchbox/platforms/cudf.py: legacy top-level module importing benchbox.experimental.gpu.
benchbox/platforms/dataframe/cudf_df.py: current DataFrame-family cuDF adapter path.
docs/platforms/support-status.md: platform inventory classified the legacy cuDF module as a removal candidate.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests -k 'cudf or dataframe_factory or optional import' --tb=short
verifications.description: Run cuDF/DataFrame routing tests after the decision.
verifications.expected: cuDF DataFrame routing and optional import behavior pass.

work_units.notes:
Search CLI, adapter factory, registry, tests, docs, and examples for the
top-level module. Distinguish direct imports from narrative docs.
work_units.summary: Revalidate whether any runtime path imports benchbox.platforms.cudf

work_units.notes:
If it is dead, remove it with tests proving DataFrame cuDF still routes
through `benchbox.platforms.dataframe`. If it is retained, document why it
imports experimental GPU helpers and what support_status applies.
work_units.summary: Choose removal, repo-only quarantine, or integration

work_units.notes:
Keep public cuDF docs aligned with the registry support status and avoid
making `benchbox.experimental` part of the supported platform surface by
accident.
work_units.summary: Update docs/tests and compatibility notes for the chosen path
